results.title: A five-layer framework for AI governance: integrating regulation, standards, and certification
results.snippet:
Purpose: The governance of artificial iintelligence (AI) systems requires a structured approach that connects high-level regulatory principles with practical implementation. Existing frameworks lack clarity on how regulations translate into conformity mechanisms, leading to gaps in compliance and enforcement. This paper addresses this critical gap in AI governance.
  Methodology/Approach: A five-layer AI governance framework is proposed, spanning from broad regulatory mandates to specific standards, assessment methodologies, and certification processes. By narrowing its scope through progress…

results.title: A Unified Policy Architecture (UPA): The Governance Kernel for Enterprise AI Operating Systems
results.snippet:
Enterprise AI is evolving into an Enterprise Operating System where autonomous AI agents can plan, reason, use memory, invoke tools, execute workflows, and collaborate with other agents. This shift creates a new governance challenge: existing authorization, security, guardrails, and compliance mechanisms are fragmented and are not designed to govern autonomous AI as a unified system.
  This paper introduces the Unified Policy Architecture (UPA), a governance architecture for Enterprise AI Operating Systems. UPA provides a unified policy model for governing AI and agents, tools, workflows, mem…

results.title: A federated architecture for sector-led AI governance: lessons from India
results.snippet: Purpose: India has adopted a vertical, sector-led AI governance strategy. While promoting innovation, such a light-touch approach risks policy fragmentation. This paper aims to propose a cohesive "whole-of-government" architecture to mitigate these risks and connect policy goals with a practical implementation plan. Design/methodology/approach: The paper applies an established five-layer conceptual framework to the Indian context. First, it constructs a national architecture for overall governance. Second, it uses a detailed case study on AI incident management to validate and demonstrate the…

results.title: Reproducibility: The New Frontier in AI Governance
results.snippet: AI policymakers are responsible for delivering effective governance mechanisms that can provide safe, aligned and trustworthy AI development. We posit that the current publication speeds in AI combined with the lack of strong scientific standards, via weak reproducibility protocols, effectively erodes the power of policymakers to ena…

# AI 治理与监管（政策、法规与标准）增量调研报告

**日期**：2026-11-11（UTC）  
**领域**：AI Governance & Regulation（政策、法规与标准）  
**检索源数量**：32 条可引用证据源（编号 [1]–[32]），其中高度相关 11 条（[3][6][7][8][13][15][16][27][30][31][32]）  
**方法论**：frontier-watch（七维增量骨架）+ evidence-grading（四轴证据分级）  

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

### 1.1 核心增量判断
近 1-2 年学术界在 **治理架构结构化**、**Agentic AI 运行时治理**、**事件治理体系化**、**可复现性作为治理指标** 四个方向产出增量预印本，但**中美欧三大司法管辖区的正式法规、行政命令、技术标准（ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42、NIST AI RMF 更新、CEN/CENELEC JTC 21、中国《生成式 AI 服务管理暂行办法》落地标准）均无一次来源覆盖** > 待核实。

### 1.2 关键进展条目（按时间倒序）

| # | 进展 | 时间 | 机构/来源 | 一句话贡献 | 证据四轴 |
|---|------|------|-----------|------------|----------|
| 1 | **Unified Policy Architecture (UPA)** | 2026-09 | arXiv cs.AI [6] | 首次系统化定义 Enterprise AI OS 的“治理内核”，覆盖授权、安全护栏、运行时义务、人工审批、合规、业务规则、Agent-to-Agent 交互 | **热度**：> 待核实（预印本无引用/star数据） **权威**：B（arXiv 预印本，未同行评审） **关注度**：中（Agentic AI 热点切中度高） **推荐度**：★★★☆☆（技术架构视角强，政策法规视角弱） |
| 2 | **AI Governance Control Stack** | 2026-04 | arXiv cs.CY [15] | 提出从策略指导下沉到运行稳定性机制的控制栈，填补可审计、可问责、长期稳定的工程化空白 | **热度**：> 待核实 **权威**：B **关注度**：中（治理工程化讨论热度上升） **推荐度**：★★★☆☆（概念模型清晰，缺开源实现） |
| 3 | **Operational AI Deployment Assurance (OADA)** | 2026-05 | arXiv cs.AI [13] | 面向高风险 AI 的部署就绪性、整改进展、升级状态、保证驱动部署控制的治理状态编排框架 | **热度**：> 待核实 **权威**：B **关注度**：中（高风险 AI 部署治理操作化需求大） **推荐度**：★★★☆☆（理论贡献大，工程落地待验证） |
| 4 | **Open Problems in AI Incident Governance** | 2026-07 | arXiv cs.CY [16] | 系统梳理事件治理的定义、分类学、监测、上报、分析五大开放问题，为红队/事后审计平台提供需求基线 | **热度**：> 待核实 **权威**：B **关注度**：中（事件治理成新兴热点） **推荐度**：★★★☆☆（问题清单完整，适合需求分析输入） |
| 5 | **Reproducibility as Governance Frontier** | 2025-10 | arXiv cs.AI [8] | 将可复现性提升为治理核心指标，指出政策信息环境低信噪比导致监管俘获与风险优先级分歧 | **热度**：> 待核实 **权威**：B **关注度**：中（证据基础治理理论倡议） **推荐度**：★★★☆☆（为治理度量提供新维度） |
| 6 | **Five-Layer Governance Framework** | 2025-09 | arXiv cs.CY [3] | 监管授权→标准→评估方法→认证流程→合规执行五层框架，配公平性与事件上报两案例验证 | **热度**：> 待核实 **权威**：B **关注度**：中（结构化范式易被后续引用） **推荐度**：★★★☆☆（提供法规-标准-认证链条模板） |
| 7 | **India Sector-Led Federated Architecture** | 2026-03 | arXiv cs.CY [7] | 基于五层框架分析印度行业主导治理的碎片化风险，提出联邦化“全政府”协调架构 | **热度**：> 待核实 **权威**：B **关注度**：低（单一国家案例） **推荐度**：★★☆☆☆（仅作比较治理参考） |

> **增量小结**：以上均为 2025-2026 年 arXiv 预印本（证据等级 B），**无同行评审论文、官方公报、法律数据库等 A 级证据**支撑中美欧正式政策进展 > 待核实。
